x-m-m1-10.title: Ingabe imvamisa enkulu isho ukuthi benze kangcono?
x-m-m1-10.goal: Funda inkinga yokuqhathanisa imvamisa injengoba injalo uma amakilasi amabili enamanani ahlukile abafundi, bese uhlukanisa lokho ithebula likuvumela ukuthi ukusho ngokuqinisekile nalokho elingakuvumeli.
x-m-m1-10.material:
Ikilasi 1 (abafundi abangu-20) neKilasi 2 (abafundi abangu-50) babhale isivivinyo sezibalo esifanayo. Ithebula lokusatshalaliswa kwemvamisa elinamaphuzu ahlukaniswe ngezikhawu ezintathu lilokhu:
Isikhawu / Ikilasi 1 (abafundi abangu-20) / Ikilasi 2 (abafundi abangu-50)
Okungaphansi kwamaphuzu angu-60 / abafundi abangu-2 / abafundi abangu-10
Amaphuzu angu-60 noma ngaphezulu kodwa angaphansi kwangu-80 / abafundi abangu-10 / abafundi abangu-25
Amaphuzu angu-80 noma ngaphezulu / abafundi abangu-8 / abafundi abangu-15
UMinji uthe, "Kunabafundi abaningi abanamaphuzu angu-80 noma ngaphezulu eKilasini 2, abangu-15, ngakho iKilasi 2 lenze kangcono ekuhlolweni."

x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Iqiniso lokuthi amaphoyinti amathathu anobude obufanayo alinye alinakho ukulungisa isizathu esisodwa. Sidinga olunye ulwazi (ukuphakama kwethangi, ukuthi amanzi asaphakelwa yini).

x-m-m1-03.title: Ukuhlola isimangalo esithi 'inombolo encane inenani eliphelele elincane nalo'
x-m-m1-03.goal: Akha isibonelo esiphikisayo somthetho jikelele mayelana namanani aphelele nokuhleleka kosayizi, futhi uthole isimo lapho usebenza khona.
x-m-m1-03.material: USeoyun wathi, "Phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili, encane inenani eliphelele elincane nalo. 3<7, futhi |3|=3 no-|7|=7, ngakho 3<7, akunjalo?" (U-|a| ufundwa 'inani eliphelele luka-a,' futhi liyibanga phakathi kuka-0 no-a kulayini wezinombolo.)
x-m-m1-03.prereq.0: Izindawo zezinombolo eziphelele nezinombolo ezinengxenye kulayini wezinombolo
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.prompt: Yenza izibonelo eziphikisana nesimangalo sikaSeoyun usebenzisa izinombolo ezimbili (a, b) lapho u-a<b kodwa u-|a| mkhulu kuno-|b|. Udinga izibonelo ezimbili lapho uphawu luka-b luhlukile (aphozithivu, 0, negethivu), njengesinye lapho u-b ephozithivu nesinye lapho u-b enegethivu.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma u-a mkhulu kuno-0.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi u-a kumele abe uhlangothi luni luka-0 kulayini wezinombolo, bese ukhetha u-b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.ok.c2: Inani eliphelele luka-a likhulu kunenani eliphelele luka-b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.fail.c2: Inani eliphelele luka-a alikhulu kunenani eliphelele luka-b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.explain: U-a kumele abe negethivu. Izibonelo: u-(−5, 2) unika u-−5<2 kodwa u-|−5|=5>|2|=2, futhi u-(−5, −2) unika u-−5<−2 kodwa 5>2. Izibonelo ezinou-b ephozithivu nezinou-b enegethivu zombili zingenzeka.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.prompt: Khetha esinye sezibonelo owasithola futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani isimangalo sikaSeoyun siphosile.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezimbili esibonelweni osikhethile nama-absolute value azo amabili eceleni komunye nomunye.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kudingeka izibonelo ezingaki ukuze kwephulwe igama elithi 'njalo.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Esibonelweni osikhethile, ingabe u-a<b iyiqiniso ngempela?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ubonise ukuthi osayizi bamanani aphelele baphuma ngokuphambene nesimangalo sikaSeoyun?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.model.0: Isibonelo, u-−5<2, kodwa inani eliphelele luka-−5, okungu-5, likhulu kunenani eliphelele luka-2, okungu-2, ngakho isimangalo siphosile. Noma isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa senza u-'njalo' abe yinhlamba.

x-m-m1-03.s.s2.prompt: Ungasho nini ukuthi u-'uma u-a<b, bese u-|a|<|b|' kumele kube yiqiniso?
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha inombolo eyodwa efanelana nesimo senketho ngayinye, futhi uhlole ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo owasenza ngaphambilini singavela yini ngaphansi kwalowo mbandela.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Uma isibonelo esiphikisayo singavela ngaphansi komibandela, asihambisani no-'kumele sisebenze.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.a: Ezinombolweni ezinegethivu, ukuhleleka kuphambene empeleni. −5<−2, kodwa amanani aphelele angu-5>2.

x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.d: Uma u-a enegethivu, isimangalo kwesinye isikhathi siyasebenza, njengo-−2<5, futhi kwesinye siyaphuka, njengo-−5<2, ngakho akusona u-'kumele sisebenze.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.explain: Uma zombili izinombolo zingu-0 okungenani, inani eliphelele yinombolo uqobo, ngakho ukuhleleka kuyafana. Uma u-a enegethivu, isimangalo siyasebenza ngenhlanhla kwamanye amacala njengo-−2<5, kodwa siyaphuka emacaleni anjengo-−5<2, ngakho asikwazi ukusho u-'kumele sisebenze.'

x-m-m1-01.material:
Inombolo u-N yahlukaniswa ngezinombolo eziyinhloko, futhi izinombolo zayo eziyinhloko kwakungu-2 no-3 kuphela. Ngakho u-N uyimikhiqizo ka-'2 ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-a' no-'3 ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-b' (u-a no-b yizinombolo zemvelo ezingenani elingu-1 okungenani).
Isibonelo, 12 = 2²×3 (u-2 ophindaphindwe kabili, u-3 kanye). Uma sibhala izihlukanisi zika-12 (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12) ngokuthi 'kangaki u-2 uphindaphindwa, kangaki u-3 uphindaphindwa,' sithola lokhu okulandelayo.
